# PEEKMARQUEE

> Your coding agent, live. Anyone can watch it build.

One command. `npx peekmarquee` in the folder where Claude Code is running prints a public link in seconds.
See exactly what would be sent: `npx peekmarquee --dry-run`.

Ticker: $MARQ (PEEKMARQUEE). Launch: Fri 6 Nov 2026 15:00 UTC. Official CA is only posted on peekmarquee.live and @peekmarquee. Anything else is not us.

## Facts
- Secrets are hidden on your machine, before anything leaves it. The relay runs the same filter again.
- Read-only. Viewers can't type into your session; there is no channel from the page back to your terminal.
- Replays stay 24 hours, then they're deleted. Delete earlier with `npx peekmarquee delete <id>`.
- Unlisted streams: `--private` keeps the link out of the directory and the stats.
- Tips go straight to the streamer's wallet through a tiny contract that holds nothing.
- Not audited. The contract is 1 function and holds no ETH; read it on Blockscout.
- Works with Claude Code.
- The CLI's source is readable in the npm tarball (no minification).
- PEEKMARQUEE is free. Nothing here needs the token.
- No promise of returns. Creator fee goes to the team wallet and pays for the relay and domain.

## What it can't catch
- Secrets without a known prefix and with low entropy are not caught unless a keyword is on the same line.
- Secrets split across lines, spelled out character by character, or inside an image are not caught.
- Private content that is not a secret (names, emails, printed database rows) is not hidden unless you use `--hide`.
- Redaction uses regular expressions, not an understanding of context. Transaction hashes and addresses stay visible.
- Don't stream a session that holds production credentials.

## API (JSON, GET allows any origin)
- GET /api — route index
- GET /api/live — public live streams
- GET /api/recent — last 20 public replays
- GET /api/stats — totals from real streams
- GET /api/s/<id> — stream meta
- GET /api/s/<id>/events?from=<seq> — server-sent events (live + replay)
- GET /api/s/<id>/replay.jsonl — replay download
- GET /api/tips?stream=<id>, GET /api/tips/top — tips read from Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663)
- POST /api/s/<id>/report {"reason":"illegal|secret_leaked|spam|other"}

## Contract
TipJar on Robinhood Chain (4663): see https://peekmarquee.live/proof and https://peekmarquee.live/deployments.json
